summary: Iteration 69: Verified ScoutMePlay landing-page improvements (compact reviews carousel, WhatsInside image cards, dark trust-strip, filtered demo videos, guest FinalCta -> /upload) plus admin Reviews management. 9/9 backend pytest passed and all frontend testids verified via Playwright on the public URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend admin DELETE /api/admin/reviews/{id} works (verified manually); however the same call inside pytest fixture cleanup left two TEST_iter69 reviews behind on first run — likely a race with the public GET cache. Test now cleans up correctly on retry. Consider invalidating the reviews cache after admin create/delete.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_iter69 reviews were created during POST validation tests and DELETED (verified via GET /api/reviews returning exactly the 6 seeded reviewers: Noah, Mette, Lucas, Sofia, Jonas, Elias).

Backend enforces text max=50, stars 0..5 (422 on violation). GET /api/demo-videos correctly filters missing files and returns empty list (DB docs preserved).
